interface.signature: n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int] -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The lengths of leftChild and rightChild must both be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= x <= n - 1 for x in leftChild + rightChild)
preconditions.description: Each element in leftChild and rightChild must be between -1 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The function returns true if there is exactly one valid binary tree formed by the nodes.
